AGRARIAN.Definition: based on farming and growing crops

HARVEST.Definition: the crops gathered from the fields at the end of the growing season

DROUGHT.Definition: a long period with little or no rain

FAMINE.Definition: a serious shortage of food that makes many people starve

POLICYMAKERS.Definition: people who decide a government's plans and rules

RENEWED.Definition: fresh; made again after earlier ones

ILLUSTRATE.Definition: show clearly by using an example

REGENERATING.Definition: making healthy and full of life again

COUNTERPARTS.Definition: people in a similar position or role in another place

THEORETICAL.Definition: based on ideas rather than on real experience

ILLUSION.Definition: a false idea that seems real

LEGISLATION.Definition: a law or set of laws

GUARANTEES.Definition: promises by a company to repair or replace a product if it breaks

RESILIENCE.Definition: the ability to recover quickly from difficulties

GOVERNANCE.Definition: the way a country is run and controlled

CHRONIC.Definition: lasting a long time and hard to cure

APPROACH.Definition: a way of dealing with something

PURSUIT.Definition: the continued effort to achieve something

RANK.Definition: are placed at a position in a list

MINDSET.Definition: a person's attitude and way of thinking
